title: Poetry
note: Quiet moral reckoning on guilt and beauty; durable and uncompromised.

title: La La Land
note: Lush musical craft, bittersweet ending lingers; thematically slight.

title: Seven Samurai
note: Foundational action grammar; class and sacrifice rendered with enduring depth.

title: In the Mood for Love
note: Restraint and longing made indelible; mood persists for weeks.

title: Parasite
note: Tight class allegory, formally controlled tonal shifts; broadly acclaimed.

title: City Lights
note: Final scene indelible; comedy and pathos perfectly fused, timeless.

title: Spirited Away
note: Inexhaustible imaginative world; emotionally durable, formally rich animation.

title: The Godfather
note: Tragedy of corruption rendered with operatic control; endlessly rewatchable.

title: 12 Angry Men
note: Tight chamber drama on doubt and justice; sincere, slightly schematic.

title: A Separation
note: Moral complexity without villains; truth and class examined unflinchingly.

title: Portrait of a Lady on Fire
note: Gaze and memory examined rigorously; aching emotion lingers durably.

title: Moonlight
note: Identity and tenderness rendered with formal poise; emotionally indelible.

title: 2001: A Space Odyssey
note: Perceptual shift on evolution and cosmos; formally radical, divisive yet supreme.

title: The Tree of Life
note: Grace and grief at cosmic scale; genuinely split between acclaim and dismissal.

title: Mulholland Drive
note: Dream logic reorganizes narrative; inexhaustible, demanding, hauntingly durable.

title: Synecdoche, New York
note: Mortality and art examined relentlessly; ambitious, sprawling, genuinely divisive.

title: Jeanne Dielman
note: Real-time domestic labor reorganizes duration; radical feminist form, endurance-testing.

title: Antichrist
note: Grief and nature's cruelty; provocative, formally striking, fiercely polarizing.

title: Holy Motors
note: Metamorphosis as cinema's essence; inventive, mysterious, exhilarating, somewhat divisive.

title: Uncut Gems
note: Relentless anxiety engine; formally controlled chaos, exhausting yet durable.

title: Beau Is Afraid
note: Anxiety odyssey, ambitious but bloated; sharply split between admirers and detractors.

title: Close-Up
note: Truth, fiction, and cinema fused; reorganizes documentary form, profoundly humane.

title: Enemy
note: Doppelganger dread, controlled atmosphere; cryptic ending divides serious viewers.

title: Climax
note: Bodily descent into chaos; virtuosic form, thematically thin, deliberately abrasive.

title: Batman Returns
note: Gothic auteur excess in blockbuster shell; stylish, uneven, modestly divisive.

title: Top Gun: Maverick
note: Superb practical spectacle, emotionally efficient; thematically conservative crowd-pleaser, low durability.

title: Ocean's Eleven
note: Effortless ensemble craft; pure pleasurable surface, durably enjoyable but slight.

title: Ant-Man
note: Competent formula heist comedy; disposable, franchise-bound, little durable value.

title: John Wick
note: Legible action choreography and world-building; distinct craft, thematically minimal.

title: Crazy Rich Asians
note: Glossy rom-com, cultural milestone; conventional craft, pleasant then largely gone.

title: The Hangover
note: Sharp comic premise; mostly disposable raunch, fades after one viewing.

title: Jurassic World
note: Nostalgia-mining spectacle; self-aware yet hollow, manipulative, evaporates quickly.

title: Knives Out
note: Clever genre clockwork with mild social bite; satisfying, accessible, modestly durable.

title: The Intouchables
note: Warm crowd-pleaser, emotionally effective; sentimental, racially uneasy, formally conventional.

title: Free Guy
note: Pleasant high-concept comedy; brand-laden, conventional, pleasant then largely forgotten.

title: Babylon
note: Maximalist Hollywood elegy; energetic spectacle exhausts subject, sharply divides critics.

title: Cloud Atlas
note: Vaulting interwoven ambition, uneven execution; genuinely split between profound and risible.

title: The Counselor
note: Bleak fatalist parable, dense McCarthy dialogue; mannered, polarizing, oddly durable.

title: Joker
note: Scorsese-pastiche character study; provocative pose over substance, fiercely divisive.

title: Don't Look Up
note: Blunt climate satire; smug, broad, didactic, genuinely split between praise and scorn.

title: Star Wars: The Last Jedi
note: Subversive franchise entry; ambitious within constraints, notoriously fractures its audience.

title: Sucker Punch
note: Hyperstylized nesting fantasy; muddled empowerment claims undercut by leering excess.

title: Spring Breakers
note: Hypnotic critique of hedonist consumerism; formally bold, deliberately divisive, durable.

title: The Fountain
note: Earnest mortality meditation, visually ambitious; reaches beyond grasp, sharply divides.

title: Southland Tales
note: Sprawling apocalyptic satire; chaotic, overstuffed, cult-divisive between visionary and incoherent.

title: Suicide Squad
note: Incoherent edit, cynical needle-drops; tonally chaotic, hollow, manufactured product.

title: Vox Lux
note: Pop-culture and trauma essay; formally bold, cold, ambitious, genuinely divisive.

title: Avatar: The Way of Water
note: Immersive technical landmark; thin story and theme, spectacle outruns substance.

title: Mamma Mia!
note: Exuberant jukebox confection; ramshackle craft, infectious yet wholly disposable.

title: Now You See Me
note: Flashy magician caper; cheats its own twists, slick but hollow.
